detail: SQLite files are binary and unmergeable, so committing the db would trade one problem for another; a per-ULID export tree union-merges across branches with zero conflicts while WAL handles same-machine concurrency. Mirrors git's own object-store/index split.
summary: SQLite is the runtime store and git is the replication transport — twining.db is a gitignored derived cache, the committed truth is a per-record export tree
